```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |> 
  glimpse()
```

```{r}
read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |> 
  select(births, year) |> 
  summary()
```

```{r}
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |> 
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(
    day_of_week,
    levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))
```
